connector.name: medium-ops
connector.registryDescription: Medium CLI + 23-tool MCP server. Your IDE drafts replies. No API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package medium-ops. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 06ketan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MEDIUM_INTEGRATION_TOKEN
env.description: Legacy Medium Integration Token (api.medium.com/v1/*). Optional. Generate at medium.com/me/settings → 'Integration tokens' (note: Medium stopped issuing new tokens in 2023).

env.name: MEDIUM_SID
env.description: Medium 'sid' cookie value from medium.com (Application → Cookies). Used for authenticated reads + dashboard GraphQL.

env.name: MEDIUM_UID
env.description: Medium 'uid' cookie value. Required alongside sid for some authenticated endpoints.

env.name: MEDIUM_XSRF
env.description: Medium 'xsrf' cookie value. Required for any dashboard write (post_response, publish_post, delete_post, draft updates).

env.name: MEDIUM_CF_CLEARANCE
env.description: Cloudflare 'cf_clearance' cookie. Only required when Cloudflare challenges your IP for dashboard write calls.

env.name: MEDIUM_USERNAME
env.description: Your Medium handle (without the @). Required for the public RSS read path so the client knows whose feed to fetch.

env.name: MEDIUM_OPS_MCP_PATH
env.description: Override path to the mcp.json file the auth layer reads. Defaults to ~/.cursor/mcp.json.

env.name: MEDIUM_OPS_LLM_CMD
env.description: Optional: override the host CLI used by the unattended daemon path (default: auto-detect claude / cursor-agent / codex on PATH). Use {prompt} placeholder if your CLI takes the prompt as an arg.
